_sample: FICTIONAL email of the US sandbox (the real one is written by the generate-savior skill)
subject: Your built-ins deserve a better website
body:
Hi,

Your work is better than your website shows: one short page, no photos, and it doesn't fit on a phone. I built a new one for Wrenhaven Carpentry so you can see it already done: https://harborpine.example/demo/wrenhaven

If it's not for you, no problem at all.

Sam
